newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei ends down but back above 20,000 level.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei ends down but back above 20,000 level.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key benchmark bounced back somewhat by the end of the Friday session to above the 20,000 threshold, after plunging by nearly 550 points earlier due to weakness on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 finished 159.81 points or 0.78 percent down at 20,341. Its March futures shed 230 points to land at 20,310.
"In anticipation of pension fund buying due next week, buying emerged shortly before the market close, buoying the Nikkei average," a trader at a foreign brokerage said.
